"""Final edge cases: root name behaviour, CNAME to root, empty zone array."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import Checks, prof, query, rec

c = Checks()

def R(q, p, rcode, term, final, answer, trace):
    return {'query': q, 'profile': p, 'rcode': rcode, 'termination': term,
            'final_name': final,
            'answer': [{'owner': o, 'type': t, 'data': d} for o, t, d in answer],
            'trace': trace}

def full(name, doc, runs, diag=None):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    ok = p.returncode == 0 and not p.stderr and p.stdout.endswith(b'\n')
    if not ok:
        c.check(name, False, 'rc=%r err=%r out=%r' % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:200], p.stdout[:120]))
        return
    got = json.loads(p.stdout)
    if got['runs'] != runs:
        c.check(name, False, 'got %s want %s' % (json.dumps(got['runs']), json.dumps(runs)))
        return
    if diag is not None and got['diagnostic'] != diag:
        c.check(name, False, 'diag %s want %s' % (got['diagnostic'], diag))
        return
    c.check(name, True)

P = prof('p', 4)

# X1a: root zone with no records, query for the root -> existing exact name, NODATA
full('X1a root zone empty, root query', {'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': []}],
    'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': '.', 'type': 'A', 'cost': 1}],
    'observations': []},
    [R('q', 'p', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', '.', [], ['.'])],
    {'equivalence': [['p']], 'basis': [], 'cost': 0, 'count': 0})

# X1b: no root zone at all, root query -> outside
full('X1b no root zone, root query', {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': []}],
    'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': '.', 'type': 'A', 'cost': 1}],
    'observations': []},
    [R('q', 'p', 'REFUSED', 'OUTSIDE', '.', [], ['.'])])

# X2: root zone with a record directly at the root
full('X2 record at the apex of the root zone', {'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [
        rec('.', 'TXT', 'apex')]}],
    'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'qt', 'name': '.', 'type': 'TXT', 'cost': 1},
                                 {'id': 'qa', 'name': '.', 'type': 'A', 'cost': 1}],
    'observations': []},
    # qa -> source '.' exists, no A -> NODATA ; qt -> ANSWER
    [R('qa', 'p', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', '.', [], ['.']),
     R('qt', 'p', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', '.', [('.', 'TXT', 'apex')], ['.'])])

# X6: a CNAME whose target is the root itself
full('X6 cname target is the root', {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [
        rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', '.')]}],
    'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.test.', 'type': 'A', 'cost': 1}],
    'observations': []},
    [R('q', 'p', 'NOERROR', 'EXTERNAL', '.', [('a.test.', 'CNAME', '.')], ['a.test.', '.'])])

# X7: no zones at all, one query -> outside for every profile
full('X7 no zones', {'zones': [], 'profiles': [prof('p1'), prof('p2', 0, 'stop', 'off')],
    'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.b.', 'type': 'AAAA', 'cost': 7}], 'observations': []},
    [R('q', 'p1', 'REFUSED', 'OUTSIDE', 'a.b.', [], ['a.b.']),
     R('q', 'p2', 'REFUSED', 'OUTSIDE', 'a.b.', [], ['a.b.'])],
    {'equivalence': [['p1', 'p2']], 'basis': [], 'cost': 0, 'count': 0})

# X9: cname target is an empty nonterminal -> NODATA keeps the accumulated aliases
full('X9 alias into an empty nonterminal', {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [
        rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'empty.test.'), rec('x.empty.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}],
    'profiles': [P], 'queries': [{'id': 'q', 'name': 'a.test.', 'type': 'AAAA', 'cost': 1}],
    'observations': []},
    [R('q', 'p', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', 'empty.test.',
       [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'empty.test.')], ['a.test.', 'empty.test.'])])

# X10: multiple observations for the same run, several identical basis-cost queries
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 't.', 'records': [rec('a.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'),
                                             rec('*.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('rfc', 4), prof('off', 4, 'follow', 'off')],
       'queries': [query('q', 'x.t.', 'A', 5), query('r', 'y.t.', 'A', 5),
                   query('s', 'z.t.', 'A', 3)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'z1', 'query': 'q', 'profile': 'rfc',
                          'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                     'answer': [rec('x.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')]}},
                         {'id': 'z2', 'query': 'r', 'profile': 'off',
                          'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NXDOMAIN', 'answer': []}}]}
full('X10 tie basis and repeated observations', doc, [
    R('q', 'off', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'x.t.', [], ['x.t.']),
    R('q', 'rfc', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'x.t.', [('x.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')], ['x.t.']),
    R('r', 'off', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'y.t.', [], ['y.t.']),
    R('r', 'rfc', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'y.t.', [('y.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')], ['y.t.']),
    R('s', 'off', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'z.t.', [], ['z.t.']),
    R('s', 'rfc', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'z.t.', [('z.t.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')], ['z.t.'])],
    None)
# any single query of cost 3 (only 's' has cost 3) is the cheapest basis
import itertools
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                   input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True)
diag = json.loads(p.stdout)['diagnostic']
c.check('X10 basis is the cheapest single query', diag['basis'] == ['s'] and diag['cost'] == 3
        and diag['count'] == 1, diag)

sys.exit(c.done('final edge tests'))
